text:
The evidence file labels no parameter high. Each label comes with a reason, a contradicts field and an origin. Conflicts are recorded as source or parameter pairs. The sex-ratio conflict is flagged as undecided: it may be a difference of place rather than a true conflict.

Main limits of the tables:
- Most values rest on one origin, palomares2005, from a small protected Doñana subpopulation.
- Many low and high bounds are our own choices.
- The food thresholds are assumptions, not measured minimums.
- The catsg and EU report claims name no study or are second-hand.
- Mortality is one all-cause rate, with no age or status detail.
